messages:
dana: Heads-up — vendor (CloudHSMX) posted a firmware advisory with a potential CVE affecting remote attestation. hearing from legal that customers with BYOK want clarity on custody guarantees. @maria can you advise on immediate RBAC/audit changes?

maria: thanks. first priorities: 1) confirm which HSMs we have with CloudHSMX 2) capture all key ops in immutable audit logs 3) lock down RBAC to prevent any new key-imports until patch validated.

sahil: inventory done — two dedicated pools in eu-west-1 running that firmware. also a couple of older reserved boxes in staging.

dana: ok, do we have an automatic key-rotation path that doesn't require HSM firmware change? i.e., can we rewrap customer CMKs through a secondary KMS provider?

maria: yes, but we need an approved fallback policy. options: a) rewrap to our KMS (software-backed) with customer consent + audit trail; b) broker to another HSM provider (longer). We must record explicit customer opt-in in audit.

olivia: for ML infra, any change to key custody will break model encryption at rest unless we patch the key unwrap path. we need a migration plan that supports in-place rewrap or dual-encryption.

kevin: from compliance: SOC2/HIPAA customers require proof of key custody chain and access logs. we must not switch to software KMS for those customers without engagement. create per-customer runbook.

maria: agreed. immediate technical controls I'm proposing: 
- RBAC: freeze new key imports, require 2-approver flow for any key export-like ops.
- Audit: enable immutable export of KMS audit events to GCS/S3 with retention 2y and write-only ACLs.
- Telemetry: add a high-cardinality tag `hsm_firmware:CloudHSMX-1.2.3` to all key ops for tracing.

dana: example audit filter for ops team?

maria: use this as a quick grep: 
```
resource.type=kms_key AND jsonPayload.event IN ("ImportKeyMaterial","RewrapKey","CreateGrant") AND labels.hsm_firmware="CloudHSMX-1.2.3"
```

sahil: can we get an automated alert when any grant or rewrap occurs on affected firmware?

maria: yes — rule: any CreateGrant or RewrapKey on affected firmware triggers sev-2 alert to sec-oncall + pagerduty.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0412. Notifying sec-oncall.

kevin: for BYOK customers we need to verify custody boundary language: if we rewrap with our software KMS, are we enumerating that keys are no longer in customer-controlled HSM? get legal to sign off.

dana: legal looped in already, but we need a technical attestation artifact showing when/where rewraps happened and which operator approved.

maria: add to audit payload: approver_ids, ticket_id, and customer_consent_version. schema change limited to string fields so downstream parsers unaffected.

olivia: also record model-serving node hashes when keys used, so we can prove which workloads had access during rotation window. small perf cost but worth it for compliance.

sahil: quick question on RBAC: do we want to add temporary scoped roles for emergency rewraps (ttl 1h) or require full admin privileges?

maria: prefer short-lived emergency role: create role `kms.emergency_rewrap` with TTL and require `2fa` + audit log entry.

kevin: vulnerability triage note: run P0 customer list — list any customers explicitly requiring HSM custody. we'll coordinate comms cadence (legal + AE).

dana: action items: 
- sahil: enable audit export + alert rule (ETA 1h)
- maria: draft RBAC freeze + emergency role policy (ETA 2h)
- olivia: sketch migration steps for model infra (ETA 3h)
- kevin: compile list of impacted BYOK customers and comms draft (ETA 2h)

maria: putting PR for RBAC policy in #eng-infra, will tag sec-review. small snippet: 
```
resource "redwood_iam_role" "kms_emergency_rewrap" {
  name = "kms.emergency_rewrap"
  ttl_seconds = 3600
  require_2fa = true
  allowed_actions = ["kms:RewrapKey","kms:CreateGrant"]
}
```

kevin: also recommend we run an audit job to verify there are no undisclosed imported key-materials (BYOK imports) in non-prod.

dana: thanks. i'll consolidate updates and ping legal for consent template. if anyone sees unexpected grants after alert rule goes live, ping me directly. :eyes:
